in_marathi.name: Anshitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ansh - Desire, Isha - Goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anshitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anshitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Ansh’ meaning desire and ‘Isha’ meaning Goddess. This name signifies a strong connection to the divine and a deep inner desire to fulfill one's spiritual aspirations.
